cells.note: The study was a clustered randomized controlled trial; this result is a within-intervention-group pre/post contrast.

O.outcome_detail: TLFB number of drinks consumed in the past 30 days

cells.quote: Nonetheless, no significant differences in alcohol consumption were observed at 4 months post intervention ( Mdn = 5.5 ) compared to prior the intervention ( Mdn = 7 ), T = 13, p = 0.18, r = 0.09.
cells.note: The non-significant result is coded ns because no equivalence test or adequate-power conclusion is reported.

O.outcome_detail: number of alcoholic drinks consumed in the past 30 days

cells.quote: On the other hand, the control group significantly consumed more alcohol at a 4 month post-intervention (Mdn = 6) period compared to the pre-intervention period (Mdn = 4), T = 16, p = 0.02, r = 0.20.
cells.note: This is the within-group information-only control-versus-baseline contrast reported in the study; the authors interpret it as a possible increase that the expectancy challenge may have prevented.

O.outcome_detail: AEQ-A Scale 2 enhanced social behaviour expectancies

cells.quote: Statistical analysis revealed a significant difference in Scale 2 AE scores in the intervention group ( Mdn  = 6) when compared to the control group ( Mdn  = 8.5), U = 1013, p <0.001, r = 0.40.

cells.quote: On the other hand, Scale 6 AE scores did not reveal any significant differences between the intervention (Mdn  = 2) and control (Mdn  = 3), U= 1544, p = 0.13, r= 0.11.
